_about: FL Studio's stock instruments (generators) in plain words - our own notes. edition = lowest FL edition that includes it (fruity < producer < signature < all_plugins), kept in line with flh_catalog's NATIVE_MIN; verify=true = unconfirmed detail.

cards.title: 3x Osc
cards.summary: Simple three-oscillator synth: pick a waveform per oscillator, detune/mix them. Classic basses, leads and pads in seconds.
controls: waveform per oscillator (sine, triangle, square, saw, noise, custom sample)
level and pan of oscillators 2 and 3
width from phase or detune differences
settings: 3 saws, fine ±10-20 cents, stereo detune up
osc 1 sine, others off or an octave down at low level
tips: Filtering and envelopes live in the channel's settings (Instrument properties tab), not in 3x Osc itself.

cards.title: Sytrus
cards.summary: Deep FM / ring-mod / subtractive synth with 6 operators and 3 filters. Huge preset library; great for plucks, bells, e-pianos, growls.
controls: each an oscillator with its own envelope, waveform and level
which operator modulates which (frequency or ring)
settings: fast attack, short decay on carrier; small FM amount that decays quickly
tips: Start from a preset and tweak the master envelopes and filter - building FM from scratch takes practice.

cards.title: FLEX
cards.summary: Preset player with free downloadable packs (keys, pads, basses, leads, drums...). Each preset has 8 macro knobs and simple envelope/filter controls.
controls: pick sounds; download more packs from the browser
tips: Fast way to get good sounds in any edition - free with FL.
Download packs from FLEX's own browser (needs a login).

cards.title: FPC (drum pads)
cards.summary: MPC-style drum sampler: 16 pads per bank, each pad can layer several samples by velocity. Comes with kits; play pads or draw notes.
controls: click to audition, drag samples onto them
several samples per pad, split by velocity or round robin
volume, pan, tune, output (to separate mixer tracks)
tips: Each pad can go to its own mixer track (pad output) for separate processing.
Right-click a pad for MIDI note mapping.

cards.title: FL Keys
cards.summary: Light sampled piano / electric piano / clavinet. Small and fast; good for sketching and simple keys parts.

cards.title: Sampler (channel sampler)
cards.summary: What you get when you drop a sample on the channel rack: plays the sample per note, with envelopes, filter, pitch, time stretch and processing.
controls: loop, reverse, normalize, fade in/out, declick, trim
tips: For one-shots turn off looping and set the root note to C5 so the piano roll plays it at pitch.

cards.title: Slicex
cards.summary: Loop slicer: cuts a sample into slices at its hits and plays each slice from its own key. Rearrange breaks, chop samples, play slices live.
controls: detect slices from transients or a grid
puts the original groove as notes
tips: Load samples by dragging onto the Slicex waveform.

cards.title: Fruity Slicer
cards.summary: Basic beat slicer: slices a loop into beats and plays them to the project tempo; writes the slice pattern to the piano roll.
controls: how many beats the loop is

cards.title: Fruity Granulizer
cards.summary: Granular sampler: plays a sample as many tiny overlapping grains. Stretchy textures, frozen pads, glitchy movement.

cards.title: Harmor
cards.summary: Additive/subtractive synth that can also resynthesize samples (load an image or audio). Powerful for evolving sounds, bass design and sound mangling.
controls: draw or load images/audio as spectra

cards.title: Harmless
cards.summary: Additive synth that behaves like a familiar subtractive one (filter, phaser, unison). Clean, punchy leads, pads and keys; light on CPU.

cards.title: Sakura
cards.summary: Physical-modeling string synth: plucked and bowed string sounds, harps, kotos and metallic tones.

cards.title: Morphine
cards.summary: Additive synth that morphs between several sound layers over time; also resynthesizes samples.

cards.title: Ogun
cards.summary: Additive synth specialised in bright, metallic and glassy tones (bells, shimmering pads).

cards.title: PoiZone
cards.summary: Straightforward virtual-analog subtractive synth: two oscillators, filter, envelopes. Easy leads and basses.

cards.title: Sawer
cards.summary: Vintage analog-style synth with a warm character; good for retro pads and leads.

cards.title: Toxic Biohazard
cards.summary: Hybrid FM/subtractive synth with built-in effects; aggressive leads, basses and pads.

cards.title: Drumaxx
cards.summary: Physical-modeling drum synth: drums built from membrane/body models instead of samples, with a pad editor.

cards.title: Transistor Bass
cards.summary: TB-303-style bass synth with its own step sequencer (slides, accents) - acid basslines.

cards.title: Kepler / Kepler Exo
cards.summary: Newer Image-Line synth (Kepler Exo is the full version). Check your plugin list for which version you have.

cards.title: Fruity DX10
cards.summary: Simple 2-operator FM synth in the style of classic FM keyboards: e-pianos, bells, plucky basses.

cards.title: Fruity Kick
cards.summary: Tiny kick synth: a pitched sine drop with click and distortion. Quick electronic kicks or 808-ish booms.

cards.title: BassDrum
cards.summary: Kick drum synth with a sine body and a sample layer for the click; tune it to the song's key.

cards.title: Fruity DrumSynth Live
cards.summary: Synthesised drum kit (kicks, snares, hats) from presets - lightweight electronic drums.

cards.title: BooBass
cards.summary: Very simple electric bass emulation with bass/mid/treble knobs.

cards.title: Plucked!
cards.summary: Karplus-Strong plucked string: quick harp/guitar-like plucks with decay and color knobs.

cards.title: SimSynth
cards.summary: Older 3-oscillator virtual-analog synth with filter envelope and chorus; retro sounds.

cards.title: Autogun
cards.summary: Preset-only FM synth with a huge numbered bank of sounds: scroll for random inspiration.

cards.title: BeepMap
cards.summary: Turns a picture into sound (reads the image as a spectrogram). For FX and experiments.

cards.title: Wave Traveller
cards.summary: Sample player whose playback position follows an envelope: scratch and DJ-style effects.

cards.title: Fruity Soundfont Player
cards.summary: Plays .sf2 SoundFont files (general MIDI and sampled instruments).

cards.title: Layer
cards.summary: Plays several other channels at once from one channel's notes (layering) or splits the keyboard between them.

cards.title: MIDI Out
cards.summary: Sends the channel's notes and CCs out as MIDI: to hardware synths or to a plugin that listens on a MIDI port.

cards.title: Dashboard
cards.summary: Build your own control panel (knobs, sliders, buttons) that sends MIDI to hardware or plugins.

cards.title: FL Slayer
cards.summary: Older electric guitar emulation with amp/effects; legacy plugin.

cards.title: MiniSynth
cards.summary: Small, simple synth for quick sounds.

cards.title: Groove Machine Synth
cards.summary: Groovebox-style synth (from FL Studio Mobile's Groove Machine).

cards.title: DirectWave
cards.summary: Multisample sampler/recorder: map samples across keys and velocities, build sampled instruments.

cards.title: FL Studio Mobile (plugin)
cards.summary: Opens FL Studio Mobile projects and plays its instruments inside FL Studio.

cards.title: Fruity Envelope Controller
cards.summary: Draw envelopes or LFOs that play per note and drive any linked knob - note-triggered modulation for plugins without their own.

cards.title: Fruity Keyboard Controller
cards.summary: Turns the notes you play into a control value (pitch/velocity) to link to any knob.
